---
title: "Downloads"
---

The tables below hold the crop pollination accounts of the EU27 for 2000, 2006, 2012, 2018 and 2024, in Excel format. The
two results workbooks arrange the main quantities by NUTS0, NUTS2 and NUTS3, with one column per year, and the other files
are long tables that are convenient for further analysis. Monetary values are in million euro at constant 2010 prices.

The 100 m maps are too large for the repository, so they are kept in an external folder. It holds 40 GeoTIFF files in about
4.2 GB, with eight maps per year of potential, demand, actual flow and unmet demand, and of the value of the flow and of
unmet demand. A `README.md` file in that folder explains the units and how to read them.

Values for 2024 use the crop area and yield of 2018, because spatial crop data end in that year, so changes between 2018 and
2024 reflect pollination potential and national statistics and do not reflect crop relocation. The
[report](../documentation/methods/crop-pollination/index.qmd) explains how each file was produced and how to read it.
